subject: Deployment mode — pricing & next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Baxter <jordan.baxter@acmeai.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Deployment mode — pricing & next steps

Jordan — great talking earlier. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Call recap:
- Primary goal: power Acme AI's real-time assistant across web and mobile. Target is ~300M tokens/month initially, with steady growth forecasted to ~600M in 12 months.
- Latency SLO: 95th < 200ms for user-facing completions.
- Security/Compliance: SOC 2 required, US data residency, customer-managed KMS desirable for sensitive flows.
- Risk profile: High availability required during US business hours; some offline batch workloads acceptable for lower tier features.

Deployment modes discussed and what we heard you leaning toward:
- Hosted API: fastest to production, simple per-token billing, Redwood handles infra and compliance posture (we're SOC 2 ready). Good if you want low ops overhead and variable usage.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and lower unit cost at scale. Good middle ground if you need predictable latency and cost efficiency.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): for strict isolation and customer-managed infra — higher setup effort and a license/hosting cost.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) We'll send an initial cost model for the three options (hosted per-token, example reserved commit for Dedicated, and high-level Private TCO) — see attached redwood_cost_model_v1.xlsx and AcmeAI_deployment_requirements.xlsx.
2) Technical deep dive with Neha to validate throughput, seq lengths, and KV-cache expectations — propose 60 minutes next week.
3) Loop in procurement (Claire) for procurement timelines and any standard contract/PO process.

I'll follow up with the initial cost estimates and a calendar invite for the deep dive. If any of the call notes above are off, flag them and I'll update.

Thanks,
Aditya
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Baxter <jordan.baxter@acmeai.com>

Thanks Aditya — that matches my notes. A couple quick clarifications before the deep dive: 

- For Hosted API, can you give an estimated blended per-token rate at 300M and at 600M tokens/month (we're interested in both prompt+completion blended).
- For Dedicated, what does a typical reserved commit look like (monthly $ commitment, how many concurrent requests / tokens-per-second that maps to)? Any typical term lengths you recommend (monthly vs annual)?
- For Private, high-level: what are the usual first-year costs (license + onboarding), and do you have any customer references who did VPC/on-prem?

Claire is on procurement and will coordinate timelines. We prefer numbers in a simple model so procurement can do a quick TCO. Looking forward to Neha's deep dive to validate throughput assumptions.

Jordan
Head of Product
Acme AI
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Baxter <jordan.baxter@acmeai.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Claire Ng <claire.ng@acmeai.com>
Date: 2026-08-27T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment mode — pricing & next steps

Jordan / Claire — thanks. See a concise starting model below (note: these are initial estimates to help procurement; we'll confirm once we validate runtime/profile details in the deep dive). Full spreadsheet attached + link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEfGHIjklmnoPqR

1) Hosted API (Redwood managed) — blended per-token estimate (prompt+completion):
- 300M tokens/mo: ~$0.0009 per token (blended) — ~ $270k/month
- 600M tokens/mo: ~$0.00075 per token (volume tier) — ~ $450k/month
Notes: includes model execution and infra; ideal if you want minimal ops and fast rollout. No commit required.

2) Dedicated (reserved capacity) — example reserve for steady 95th <200ms profile:
- Typical commitment: $65,000/month (annual term) for a reserved pool sized to handle the 300M token/month steady profile with headroom for burst.
- Effective unit cost at 300M tokens: ~ $0.00022 per token (capacity amortized). At 600M tokens with same pool and autoscale, unit cost drops further.
- Term: annual commitments get best pricing; quarterly also possible but with higher per-unit charge.
Notes: Dedicated gives you predictable latency and lower unit economics but requires commit and can include optional dedicated support SLA.

3) Private (VPC / on-prem) — high-level first-year view:
- One-time onboarding & integration: ~$75k–$125k (depending on integrations, KMS/HSM work).
- Annual platform license: ~$250k/year (covers runtime + commercial support).
- Customer infra: server/GPUs + networking (customer-provided or we can provide sizing).
Notes: best for strict isolation or regulated workloads. TCO depends heavily on whether you host in your cloud or on-prem.

Attachments: redwood_cost_model_v1.xlsx — includes line-item assumptions (instance types, utilization, compression/quantization assumptions).

Next steps I propose:
- Technical deep dive with Neha (60m) — available Tue 9/1 or Wed 9/2. Please confirm which works.
- I'll add a simple comparison sheet to the Drive specifically for procurement (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and update numbers after our deep dive.

Happy to hop on a call to walk through the spreadsheet.

Best,
Aditya
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Jordan
